text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 30 people were killed by having their throats cut on Friday-Saturday night in Medea, south of Algiers.
- Workers massively stayed away from work in a nationwide stoppage to mourn assassinated union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda.
- President Liamine Zeroual invites party leaders for talks on February 11 over general elections planned for the first half of this year.
- The government and political opposition are urged to iron out their divergencies to ease people's sufferings.
- Opposition parties want election watchdog committee to be truly independent from the authorities to ensure a free poll.
- The National Transitional Council (CNT) to debate and vote a party law.
